svg.title: The cookie store
svg.desc: Session-only cookies (those without an expiry date) live in the daemon's memory, so they last as long as the daemon does. keepSession re-saves them with a 30-day expiry whenever a run or the daemon ends, which is what keeps single sign-on sessions alive between days. A site can still end a session on its side once it has gone unused for a while. For such a site keepSignedIn adds a launch agent that visits it every 10 minutes and then writes the cookies to disk (see sites.md).
